title: Paul reminds of the gospel and resurrection witnesses
description: Paul reminds the church of the foundational gospel he delivered: that Christ died for our sins, was buried, and rose again on the third day according to the Scriptures. He lists the witnesses who saw the risen Lord – Cephas, the twelve, more than five hundred brothers and sisters at once, James, all the apostles, and last of all himself – and confesses that by God's grace he is what he is. [ref:1 Cor 15:1-11|1 Corinthians 15:1-11]
